items.followUp: What is a non-polar covalent bond?

rubric.why: Identifies the cause of polarity in a covalent bond.
rubric.description: States that atoms with different electronegativities share the bonding electrons unequally.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating unequal sharing or a difference in electronegativity.

rubric.why: Identifies the partial charges caused by unequal sharing.
rubric.description: States that the more electronegative atom becomes partially negative and the other partially positive.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark when both partial charges are correctly identified.

modelAnswer: A covalent bond becomes polar when the bonded atoms have different electronegativities and share the bonding electrons unequally.
The more electronegative atom becomes partially negative (δ−), while the other becomes partially positive (δ+).

items.followUp: Why does hydrogen diffuse faster than carbon dioxide?

rubric.why: Compares the molecular masses of hydrogen and oxygen.
rubric.description: States that H₂ has a lower molecular mass than O₂.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for correctly comparing the molecular masses.

rubric.why: Links hydrogen's lower molecular mass to its faster diffusion.
rubric.description: States that H₂ diffuses faster than O₂.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct comparison of diffusion rates.

modelAnswer: H₂ has a much lower molecular mass than O₂.
Therefore, H₂ molecules diffuse more rapidly than O₂ molecules.

items.followUp: Define force and state its SI unit.

rubric.description: Defines pressure as force acting normally per unit area of a surface.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for defining pressure as force per unit area.

rubric.why: Identifies the SI unit of pressure.
rubric.description: States that pressure is measured in pascals (Pa), equivalent to newtons per square metre.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving pascal (Pa) or N/m².

modelAnswer: Pressure is the force acting normally per unit area of a surface.
Its SI unit is the pascal (Pa), equal to one newton per square metre (N/m²).
